name: clay-example
description: A small Clay example: a model, generated pages and handlers, and touch business logic.

scripts.generate: npm run validate && clay generate clay/model.json .
scripts.test: tsx scripts/validate-touch-specs.ts && tsx --test clay/validate-model.spec.ts src/logic/note/create.spec.ts src/logic/note/rename.spec.ts src/runtime/handlers.spec.ts
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && npm test
